0# <python:seaborn➡️fig-seaborn>

 
```{python}
#| label: fig-seaborn
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
# データの作成
np.random.seed(42)
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "sepal_width": np.random.normal(3, 0.5, 100),
    "sepal_length": np.random.normal(6, 0.8, 100),
    "species": np.random.choice(["setosa", "versicolor", "virginica"], 100)
})
# グラフの作成
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df, 
    x="sepal_width", 
    y="sepal_length", 
    hue="species",
    s=100,
    alpha=0.7
)
plt.title("Iris Data (Seaborn on Pyodide v0.27.1)")
plt.show()
```
